channel.title: Sohan Hajra · Writing
channel.description: Research proposals taken from a one-page question to running code: what I believed, what broke, and what I believe now.

item.title: 01.b · Signal Cost Confirm (sequel to 01)
item.description: Two leads from 01, checked once on twelve unseen days with the rules written first. Verdict: Supported for both. A taker acting on an extreme imbalance signal paid more the longer its order took, with the slope interval above zero on all 12 days and an extra 0.48 to 0.68 bps by 500 ms. The passive effect (C2) holds but is small.

item.title: 01 · From Signal to Fill
item.description: When market conditions are matched, does extra delay between a trading decision and its order's outcome cost price or fills? Verdict: Inconclusive. Both primary tests are null, largely by design. A taker acting on order book imbalance paid 0.52 to 0.66 bps by 500 ms on the test days, an upper end.
